changes.before: Even in ordinary practice, do not record unseen conditions as normal. If words are unclear, ask the person to indicate the place and report their words separately from unobserved matters. Absence of these textbook symptoms alone does not rule out every emergency.
changes.after: Even in ordinary practice, do not record unseen conditions as normal. If words are unclear, ask the person to indicate the place and report their words and the unobserved matters separately to the person responsible. Absence of these textbook symptoms alone does not rule out every emergency.

changes.before: Check and communicate the choice when conditions do not fit.
changes.after: Check the person’s choice when conditions do not fit and communicate it to the person responsible.

changes.after: Tell the person responsible the wishes and unconfirmed matters so they can be checked.
